name: @va-team/nabu-google-workspace
description: Per-tenant Google Drive + Calendar access. Vends short-lived OAuth access tokens fetched from the Nabu backend and exposes a single passthrough tool the agent uses against Google REST APIs.

allowNonMainAgents.description: When true, agents other than `main` may use this plugin. Default false. Product gate only — the backend remains the authorization boundary.

apiToken.description: Per-organization skill bearer issued by the GoogleWorkspace module on Nabu backend. Accepts either a literal string or a SecretRef object {source, provider, id} resolved from env.

tokenVersion.description: Monotonic counter bumped by NestJS on rotate / re-consent / disconnect; the plugin invalidates its access-token cache when this changes.

refreshIntervalMs.description: How often to re-validate the apiToken health with NestJS. Default 6h.
